sn33.4:1.2: nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn33.4:1.3: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
sn33.4:1.5: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 4
sn33.4:1.6: Saṅkharesu kho Vaccha aññāṇā saṅkhārasamudaye aññāṇā saṅkhāranirodhe aññāṇā saṅkhāranirodhagaminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā
sn33.4:1.7: evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
sn33.4:1.8: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.4:1.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 5
sn33.4:1.10: Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti
sn33.4:1.11: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.4:1.12: Neva hoti tathāgato na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || ||
